kingdom_smp.connection.required: Join a Kingdom SMP server before opening the overview.
kingdom_smp.connection.timeout: No refresh response arrived. Check the connection and try again.
kingdomsmp.screen.title: KINGDOM SMP · Royal Gilded
kingdomsmp.screen.close.help: Return to the world. Escape also closes this screen.
kingdomsmp.screen.overview.help: Read the kingdom's authoritative state and known progression gates.
kingdomsmp.screen.progression.help: Inspect twelve tiers: + attained, * current, - locked. Hover for details; scroll or Page Up/Down for text. Selecting never grants a tier.
kingdomsmp.screen.refresh.help: Request a new read-only snapshot from the server.
kingdomsmp.screen.small: Increase the window or reduce GUI scale.
kingdomsmp.screen.overview.detail: The kingdom begins at Tier 1: First Hearth. Tier, shared resource totals, and your score below come from persisted server data.
kingdomsmp.screen.gates: Known gate design (not enforced by this slice): Nether at Tier 5; End at Tier 9; Creative Energy Cube at Tier 12 with active Master Mechanic.
kingdomsmp.screen.gate.nether: Confirmed design unlock: Nether access. Enforcement is not implemented by this view.
kingdomsmp.screen.gate.end: Confirmed design unlock: End access. Enforcement is not implemented by this view.
kingdomsmp.screen.gate.cube: Confirmed design: Creative Energy Cube requires this tier AND active Master Mechanic status. This view does not grant access.
kingdomsmp.screen.gate.unspecified: No exact unlock catalogue has been approved for this tier.
kingdomsmp.screen.tier.first_hearth.targ: First Hearth approved targets: 1,024 logs (#minecraft:logs); 2,048 cobblestone; 512 wheat; 128 iron ingots. These are requirements, not live donated totals.
kingdomsmp.screen.future.requirements: Detailed requirements for later tiers await approved definitions.
kingdomsmp.screen.contributions.unavaila: Open Contribute to donate resources, inspect the live leaderboard, and review your accepted history.
kingdomsmp.screen.gate.town_hall: Ultimate Tier 12 building: Town Hall. Its blueprint follows a separately approved Tier 12 award policy. Creative Energy Cube also requires an active Master Mechanic.
kingdomsmp.screen.shared.progress: First Hearth · saved shared contributions: logs %s / 1,024; cobblestone %s / 2,048; wheat %s / 512; iron ingots %s / 128.
kingdomsmp.screen.personal.score: Your First Hearth weighted contribution: %s / 2,048 points (exact fraction).
kingdomsmp.screen.gate.founders_lodge: Completing The First Hearth advances the kingdom to Tier 2. Highest contributor earns the Founders’ Lodge construction privilege, with included materials.
